decisions.summary: No cross-team Agent assignments or exceptions; one primary team; Tenant Admin routing is within tenant and Agent must belong to ticket team; membership changes validated/audited and authorization loss revokes access immediately.

New to Open permitted for currently assigned, authorized Agent; assigned-team Manager including team-queued ticket; Tenant Admin for any own-tenant ticket including unassigned; not Platform Admin; creator gains no separate permission; server revalidation, default deny and audit.
